Rules at a glance
Validity, sittings and dates: what each regulator says
Every Irish regulator we could read limits the age of your result to about two years, but each one counts the two years from a different point. Check the wording for your own regulator.
How old can the result be?
NMBI: less than two years old. Medical Council: a single sitting within the last two years, with the certificate dated within two years of the date of registration. PSI: valid for two years from the test date. CORU: dated within two years of the day you submit your registration application. Dental Council: obtained no more than two years before you submit your application.
Which sittings can be combined?
CORU only: a maximum of two sittings, from the same test provider, the repeat within six months of the first, with no OET sub-test below C+. CORU also says the overall minimum must be met on both sittings and it does not accept single sub-test retakes. NMBI, the Medical Council and PSI want one sitting. The Dental Council does not say: not confirmed.
Dates printed by the regulators
Medical Council: its current English rules apply to applications received on or after 1 March 2025. NMBI: its English requirement applies from 2 April 2018. Dental Council: applicants from 1 November 2018 must show proficiency. PSI: from 1 June 2026 it no longer accepts a university letter saying the course was taught in English.
OET@Home
NMBI, the Medical Council, PSI and the Dental Council do not accept at-home tests. CORU's page says online or at-home versions are accepted for OET only, but it does not name OET@Home, so we treat it as not confirmed. More detail is in our OET@Home guide and our clubbing rules guide .
Before booking: the grades behind the numbers, as NMBI and CORU print them, are B from 350 and C+ from 300. Compare your target with other countries in our OET score requirements guide and our recognition by country table .
Nurses and midwives: NMBI
NMBI OET Nursing B in three, C+ in one One result only
For nurses and midwives who qualified outside the EU. NMBI describes two stages: a qualification recognition application, then a registration application. English evidence is needed at the second stage. NMBI also lists ways to show English without a test: nursing education taught and examined in English in a country it recognises (Australia, Canada, New Zealand, the United Kingdom or the United States), or three years of post-registration practice in English within the last five years. See the OET course for nurses for preparation.
English-test planning: NMBI asks for OET Nursing with grade B in three components and C+ in one. Its rule sentence does not name which component may be C+, although the table on the same page shows Writing, so aim for B in all four or ask NMBI. The result must be less than two years old. NMBI accepts one test result only and does not accept combined results. It does not accept OET at home, IELTS online or the IELTS One Skill Retake. The IELTS Academic alternative is an overall 7.0, with 7.0 in three components and 6.5 in one.
Pathway steps
Check whether you need a test Read NMBI's three English routes first. If your education or recent practice already qualifies, you may not need OET at all.
Apply for qualification recognition This is NMBI's first stage. NMBI may then ask for a compensation measure, such as a period of adaptation or an aptitude test. We have not confirmed those details: read NMBI's own guidance.
Sit OET Nursing at a venue, once Plan to reach the full score line in a single result, on paper or on computer at a test venue.
Apply for registration in time Send your English evidence with the registration application while the result is still less than two years old.
Common mistakes
Planning to combine two OET results: NMBI accepts one result only.
Booking OET@Home: NMBI does not accept it.
Sitting OET so early that the result is over two years old at the registration stage.
Assuming the UK rule applies. The NMC and NMBI are different regulators: see our UK pathway guide .
OET preparation focus
Writing
Nursing referral, discharge and transfer letters with clear purpose and selective case notes.
Speaking
Patient education, reassurance and handover role-plays in a calm nursing register.
Reading
Fast Part A scanning, then careful reading of policies and care guidance.
Listening
Nurse and patient consultations and ward briefings in different accents.
Doctors: Medical Council
Medical Council OET Medicine B in each module Single sitting
The Medical Council says its current English requirements apply to all new applications received on or after 1 March 2025. Its page lists groups who do not need to send this evidence, including graduates of Irish, EU or EEA, UK, Australian, New Zealand and US medical schools, EU citizens, and applicants for specialist, visiting EEA or internship registration. The page adds that this is likely to change. All other applicants must provide the evidence. See the OET course for doctors for preparation.
English-test planning: The Medical Council asks for the OET Medicine category with a minimum of grade B in each module, in a single sitting within the last two years. Certificates must be dated within two years of the date of registration, and older certificates are not accepted. It does not accept OET@Home, IELTS Indicator or IELTS Online. Alternatives on the same page: IELTS Academic with an overall 7.0 and at least 6.5 in each module, or Cambridge at level C1 or C2 within the last two years.
Pathway steps
Check whether you are exempt Read the list of exempt groups on the Medical Council's English language page before you book anything.
Check the PRES position The Council's PRES questions page lists exemptions, for example an equivalent internship. It names internships in Australia, New Zealand, Pakistan, South Africa, Sudan and Malaysia, with start-date conditions for Pakistan and South Africa. The structure of the PRES itself is not confirmed here.
Sit OET Medicine once All four modules at grade B or above in the same sitting, at a test venue.
Apply while the certificate is valid The certificate must still be within two years on the date of registration, not only on the day you apply.
Common mistakes
Combining modules from two sittings: the rule is a single sitting.
Booking OET@Home: the Medical Council does not accept it.
Assuming a PLAB, USMLE, AMC or MCCQE pass removes the PRES. We could not confirm that: ask the Medical Council.
Letting the certificate pass two years before registration is complete.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Referral, discharge and transfer letters with selective relevance and a formal tone.
Speaking
Consultations, explaining a diagnosis, breaking bad news and shared decisions.
Reading
Guideline extracts, drug information and workplace texts under time pressure.
Listening
Consultations, ward briefings and presentations in different accents.
Pharmacists: PSI
PSI OET Pharmacy 350, 350, 350 and Writing 300 Same sitting
The PSI language requirements apply to all pharmacists who trained outside Ireland. PSI uses level C1 of the Common European Framework as its minimum standard and currently accepts IELTS, TOEFL, CAE and OET. For pharmacists who qualified outside the EU, the PSI third-country route starts with recognition of your qualification. See the OET course for pharmacists for preparation.
English-test planning: PSI's table asks for OET Pharmacy with Listening 350, Reading 350, Speaking 350 and Writing 300. Results are valid for two years from the test date. All components must be attempted at the same sitting and PSI does not accept one-skill retakes. Home-based tests are not accepted. PSI's table also prints base scores for super-scoring, but we could not read the full rule, so it is not confirmed: plan to pass in one sitting. From 1 June 2026 PSI no longer accepts a university letter as proof that your course was in English.
OET on Computer with Speaking at home: PSI's page mentions that OET now delivers the Speaking sub-test at home through a new platform for OET on Computer candidates, but it does not clearly say that such results are accepted. That is not confirmed: ask PSI before you book.
Pathway steps
Apply for recognition of your qualification PSI says this is the first step for a qualification gained outside the EU.
Holistic Assessment PSI lists a Holistic Assessment as the next step after recognition.
MCQ and, or, OSCE The examinations are run by RCSI. PSI's page printed these 2027 dates on 27 November 2026, subject to change: 16 to 17 February, 28 to 29 July, 17 to 18 September and 19 to 20 November.
Register with your language evidence PSI asks for the language assessment when you apply for registration, so time OET to be valid at that point.
Common mistakes
Booking a home-based test: PSI does not accept it.
Planning a one-skill retake or splitting components across sittings.
Relying on a university letter about English-medium teaching after 1 June 2026.
Sitting OET at the start of a long route, so the two years run out before registration.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Letters to prescribers and other professionals with accurate medicine details.
Speaking
Medication counselling, adherence, side effects and safe refusal of a sale.
Reading
Medicine information, safety alerts and workplace policies.
Listening
Pharmacist and patient counselling and team handovers.
CORU professions: physiotherapy, occupational therapy, dietetics, optometry, podiatry, radiography, speech and language therapy
CORU Seven OET professions Three score lines Maximum two sittings
CORU is the regulator for health and social care professionals, with a registration board for each profession. Its language page lists OET for seven of them. You may not need a test if you hold a CORU-approved qualification, if you qualified in the previous two years through English or Irish, or if you lived and practised through English in an English-only country for at least two of the past five years. Course pages: OET for physiotherapists and OET for allied health professions .
Registration board OET version Minimum OET score
Physiotherapists, Occupational Therapists, Dietitians, Optical (optometrists) OET Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Dietetics or Optometry Grade B (350) in three components and at least C+ (300) in one
Podiatrists OET Podiatry Grade B in three components and at least C+ (300) in one
Radiographers OET Radiography Grade B (350) in all four components
Speech and Language Therapists OET Speech Pathology Grade B (400) in three components and B (350) in one
English-test planning: Book the OET version for your own profession and read the score line for your own board. Certificates must be dated within two years of the day you submit your registration application. CORU accepts results from a maximum of two sittings: the repeat must be with the same test provider and within six months of the first test, no OET sub-test may be below C+, and CORU says the overall minimum must be met on both sittings. It does not accept individual OET sub-test retakes. OET@Home is not confirmed: the page says online or at-home versions are accepted for OET only, without naming OET@Home, so ask CORU in writing.
Pathway steps
Find your registration board Check the score line for your profession. The three lines are not the same.
Recognition of your qualification International qualifications are assessed first. CORU may offer a compensation measure where it finds substantial differences. We have not confirmed the details or fees: read CORU's pages.
Sit your profession's OET Aim to pass in one sitting. If you need a second, keep to the same provider and the six-month limit.
Apply within two years The certificate date is counted back from the day you submit your application.
Common mistakes
Sitting OET Nursing or Medicine because more practice material exists for them.
Planning a third sitting, or a retake of one sub-test only.
Radiographers aiming for C+ in one component: CORU asks for B in all four.
Speech and language therapists aiming for 350 across the board: CORU asks for 400 in three components.
Assuming OET@Home is accepted without written confirmation from CORU.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Referral and progress letters in your own profession's register.
Speaking
Explaining assessment findings, treatment plans and home programmes in plain language.
Reading
Clinical guidance and workplace texts read for detail and for opinion.
Listening
Consultations and team briefings in different accents.
Dentists: Dental Council
Dental Council OET Dentistry B in each module OET@Home not accepted
The Dental Council says applicants for registration from 1 November 2018 must be proficient in English. Besides a test, it lists two other routes: a qualification that was undertaken in English, or practice as a fully registered dental professional in a member state where English is an official language. Dentists who qualified outside the EEA are normally required to pass the Council's special examination . See the OET course for dentists for preparation.
English-test planning: The Dental Council asks for OET Dentistry with a minimum of grade B in each module, or IELTS Academic with at least 7.0 in each module. The certificate must have been obtained no more than two years before you submit your application for registration. The Council does not currently accept OET@Home or IELTS Online. Its page does not say whether sittings can be combined: not confirmed, so plan to pass in one sitting. From January 2027 OET on Paper is for Nursing and Medicine only, so dentists sit OET on Computer at a venue.
Pathway steps
Check the three English routes A test, a qualification undertaken in English, or registered practice in a member state where English is official.
Part 1 of the examination Three written papers and an operative bench test, with a maximum of two attempts.
Part 2 of the examination Written papers, an OSCE and clinical vivas, with a maximum of three attempts.
Watch the 2027 calendar On 27 November 2026 the Council's page gave an application week of 11 to 15 January 2027, Part 1 in Dublin on 22 to 25 March 2027 and Part 2 in Cork in June 2027, dates to be confirmed. Places are allocated by random selection, so read the page before you plan.
Common mistakes
Booking OET@Home or IELTS Online: neither is currently accepted.
Sending an English certificate that is more than two years old when the completed application is received.
Assuming two sittings can be combined. The page does not say so.
Missing the short application week for the examination.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Referral letters to specialists and medical practitioners with accurate dental detail.
Speaking
Treatment options, consent, anxious patients and oral health advice.
Reading
Clinical guidance and workplace texts read at speed.
Listening
Dentist and patient consultations and professional talks.
Vets: Veterinary Council of Ireland (not confirmed)
Veterinary Council of Ireland Not confirmed
We could not open the Veterinary Council of Ireland's English language page on 27 November 2026, so we do not state a rule for vets. Whether OET Veterinary Science is accepted, the score, the validity period, the sittings rule and the position on OET@Home are all not confirmed.
English-test planning: do not book any test on the strength of this guide. Read the Veterinary Council of Ireland's English language requirements yourself, or ask the Council in writing which tests, versions and scores it accepts. Remember that from January 2027 OET on Paper is for Nursing and Medicine only, so OET Veterinary Science is a computer test at a venue.
Test formats and venues
Paper, computer or OET@Home in Ireland
Three separate questions decide your format: what OET lets you book in your country and profession, what your regulator accepts, and how Speaking is delivered. They have different answers.
OET on Paper from January 2027
OET announced on 16 November 2026 that from January 2027 the paper test continues for Nursing and Medicine only. The announcement names no countries. OET's customer care team told us by email in November 2026 that Ireland is one of the 16 countries that keep paper testing. Paper sessions are never guaranteed: see our paper test centres 2027 list for Ireland .
OET on Computer at a venue
OET says the computer test stays available for all 12 professions at approved venues, subject to availability. On 27 November 2026 the official OET finder listed computer venues in Dublin and Cork. Venues and sessions change, so check our OET test centres list for Ireland and then the finder itself.
OET@Home
OET says OET@Home is offered in countries where taking the test at a venue is not yet available. Ireland has venues, so do not plan on booking it from inside Ireland. If you sit elsewhere, your Irish regulator's rule still decides whether the result counts: four of the five we read refuse at-home tests.
Speaking by video is not OET@Home
On a computer test, and at some paper venues from 2027, the Speaking sub-test can be delivered by live video. That does not make the test OET@Home. If your Speaking will be remote, ask your regulator to confirm it accepts that format. PSI mentions it on its page without clearly saying yes.
Candidate checklist
Before you book OET for Ireland
Name your regulator: NMBI, Medical Council, PSI, CORU, Dental Council or the Veterinary Council of Ireland.
Check whether you need a test at all. Several regulators list education or practice routes.
Book the OET version for your own profession.
Write down your exact score line and whether one sitting is required.
Choose a venue test unless your regulator has confirmed OET@Home in writing.
Count the two years from the point your regulator uses, and time the test near your application.
Start with free OET practice or the free placement test to see how far you are from the score.

Ireland pathway FAQ
Short answers for healthcare professionals planning Irish registration with OET.
Does Ireland accept OET? Yes for most health professions, but each regulator sets its own rule. NMBI, the Medical Council, PSI, CORU and the Dental Council all list OET on their English language pages. We could not confirm the Veterinary Council of Ireland's rule, so vets should check with it directly.
What OET score do nurses need for NMBI? NMBI asks for OET Nursing with grade B in three components and C+ in one, in a single result that is less than two years old. NMBI does not accept combined results or OET at home.
What OET score do doctors need for the Irish Medical Council? For applications received on or after 1 March 2025, the Medical Council asks for OET Medicine with at least grade B in each module, in a single sitting within the last two years. It does not accept OET@Home.
Can I combine two OET sittings for Ireland? Only CORU's page allows it: a maximum of two sittings from the same test provider, with the repeat taken within six months and no OET sub-test below C+. NMBI, the Medical Council and PSI ask for one sitting. The Dental Council's page does not say, so plan for one sitting.
Is OET@Home accepted in Ireland? NMBI, the Medical Council, PSI and the Dental Council say they do not accept at-home tests. CORU's wording is unclear, so treat it as not confirmed and ask CORU in writing before you book.
Can I still take OET on paper in Ireland in 2027? From January 2027 OET on Paper continues for Nursing and Medicine only. OET's customer care team listed Ireland among the 16 countries that keep paper testing, but paper sessions are never guaranteed. All other professions sit OET on Computer at a venue.
Which OET version do CORU professions need? The version for your own profession. CORU lists OET Physiotherapy, Occupational Therapy, Dietetics, Optometry, Podiatry, Radiography and Speech Pathology, with three different score lines, so read the line for your registration board.
Not sure which Irish regulator or score line applies to you?
Start with free practice to see your level, then choose the course for your profession. If you are unsure which regulator covers you, message us with your profession and target country and we will point you to the right official page.

## Canada Pathway Guide 2027: Where OET Is Accepted

Canada pathway guide for OET candidates: which provincial regulators accept OET for doctors, nurses and pharmacists, which do not, and why IRCC is separate.

Canada Pathway Guide - Edition 2027
Canada Pathway Guide 2027: Where OET Is Accepted
Canada has no national health licence. Each provincial or territorial regulator decides which English test it accepts, and immigration uses a different list again. This guide shows where OET is accepted, where it is not, and what we could not confirm.

Canada overview
Choose your regulator and province first
National bodies in Canada run examinations or credential checks, but the licence comes from the regulator of one province or territory, and that regulator sets the language rule. OET is accepted by some regulators for medicine, nursing and pharmacy. For several other professions the national body lists other tests and not OET. Immigration
Immigration language tests are separate from registration
A language test for a visa and a language test for a licence are two different requirements, set by two different bodies.
IRCC does not list OET
The IRCC Express Entry language test page (dated 16 October 2026) lists CELPIP, IELTS and PTE Core for English, and TEF Canada and TCF Canada for French. OET is not mentioned. We did not read other IRCC programmes, so those are not confirmed.
You may need two tests
If your regulator accepts OET and you also apply through Express Entry, plan for one test for registration and another for immigration. An OET result does not replace an IRCC-approved test, and an IRCC-approved test may not satisfy your regulator.
Check before you pay
Some regulators accept tests that IRCC also lists. Read both lists side by side for your province and profession. If one test satisfies both bodies, that may be the cheaper route even if you prefer OET.
Doctors: MCC and the provincial colleges
Medical Council of Canada Provincial colleges OET Medicine
The Medical Council of Canada (page updated 21 July 2026) sets no language test of its own. It says that showing proficiency in English or French is part of the licensure pathway set by each medical regulatory authority, meaning the college of your province. See the OET course for doctors if your college accepts OET.
English-test planning: British Columbia: the CPSBC policy (version 2.2, effective 7 April 2026, revised 11 September 2026) asks for OET Medicine with at least grade B in each component in one sitting. Results are valid for two years from the test date and combined scores from several attempts are not accepted. You send results by adding CPSBC as a verified organisation in your myOET account. It also accepts IELTS Academic 7 in each component or CELPIP General 9 in each. Alberta: CPSA asks for OET Medicine with at least grade B in each component, completed within 24 months before your application. Whether it must be one sitting is not confirmed. Ontario: we could not open the CPSO language proficiency page . A search extract suggests OET Medicine with grade B in each sub-test, in the same sitting, within 24 months, but treat that as not confirmed. Other provinces: not confirmed. OET itself says every college with an English requirement recognises OET, but its page names no college and no score, so that is OET's claim and not a regulator's rule. OET@Home is not confirmed for any of the three colleges.
Pathway steps
Pick the province The college of that province decides the language rule, the exemptions and the route to a licence.
Open a physiciansapply.ca account MCC uses it for its services, including source verification of your medical degree.
Plan the MCC examinations MCC describes the MCCQE and the NAC Examination. The NAC is needed for the residency match and is used by some practice-ready assessment programmes. MCC changed some of its rules in 2026 and we have not confirmed the details: read its page.
Residency or practice-ready assessment MCC describes two routes: a residency through the CaRMS match, or a Practice-Ready Assessment, a 12-week workplace assessment for doctors who already practised independently. Then the LMCC and the provincial licence.
Common mistakes
Booking OET for Express Entry: IRCC does not list it.
Combining two OET sittings for CPSBC, which refuses combined scores.
Assuming one college's rule applies in another province.
Booking OET@Home. No college we read confirms it.
Forgetting to add the college in myOET, where the college asks for results that way.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Referral, discharge and transfer letters with selective relevance and a formal tone.
Speaking
Consultations, explaining a diagnosis, breaking bad news and shared decisions.
Reading
Guideline extracts, drug information and workplace texts under time pressure.
Listening
Consultations, ward briefings and presentations in different accents.
Nurses: provincial nursing regulators
Provincial regulators OET Nursing where accepted CELBAN or IELTS elsewhere
Nursing registration is provincial too, and the regulators do not agree on OET. We read Ontario, British Columbia and Alberta directly. We could not confirm the current language policy of NNAS, the national credential service: a search extract suggests it no longer collects language scores and that proof goes straight to the provincial regulator. BCCNM says internationally educated nurses applying after 31 January 2023 are assessed by Inspire Global Assessments. See the OET course for nurses if your regulator accepts OET.
English-test planning: Ontario: CNO accepts OET with Writing C+ (320), Speaking B (350), Listening B (350) and Reading C+ (330), reached in one complete attempt, with the test written within two years of registering. OET@Home is not confirmed. British Columbia: BCCNM (page updated 24 November 2026) accepts OET with Reading C+, Listening B, Writing C+ and Speaking B, in person only, with evidence no more than two years old. Whether sittings can be combined is not confirmed. Alberta: CRNA lists only CELBAN and IELTS Academic and says it does not currently accept other tests, so do not book OET for CRNA. Manitoba: the CRNM document (effective 26 March 2025) asks for a language test within the past two years and allows the minimum scores across two sittings of the same test, but it does not print the list of tests, so OET and its scores are not confirmed. Nova Scotia, Saskatchewan, Quebec, the Atlantic provinces, the territories and all practical nurse regulators: not confirmed.
Pathway steps
Choose the province and nurse category Registered nurse and practical nurse regulators can be different bodies with different lists.
Follow the assessment route your regulator names Your regulator tells you which credential assessment service to use. Do not order a report before you know.
Sit the test your regulator lists OET Nursing only where it is listed, at a venue, with the whole score line in one attempt unless the regulator says otherwise.
Send the result in time Each regulator counts the two years in its own way. Check the wording.
Common mistakes
Booking OET for Alberta: CRNA does not accept it.
Booking OET@Home for British Columbia: BCCNM is in person only.
Splitting the score line over two sittings for CNO.
Assuming an OET Nursing result also counts for Express Entry.
Using one province's score line for another province.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Nursing referral, discharge and transfer letters with clear purpose and selective case notes.
Speaking
Patient education, reassurance and handover role-plays in a calm nursing register.
Reading
Fast Part A scanning, then careful reading of policies and care guidance.
Listening
Nurse and patient consultations and ward briefings in different accents.
Pharmacists: NAPRA policy and the provincial colleges
NAPRA model policy Provincial colleges OET Pharmacy
The NAPRA Language Proficiency Requirement Policy (approved November 2023, published February 2024) is a recommendation to the provincial pharmacy regulators, not a rule of its own. Pharmacists' Gateway Canada says most jurisdictions adopted or adapted it on 1 September 2024, Manitoba on 24 March 2025 and Ontario on 1 January 2026, and that Quebec is outside this scheme. It also says scores are valid for two years from the sitting and explains how OET candidates send their results letter. See the OET course for pharmacists for preparation.
English-test planning: NAPRA policy: OET is one of the recommended tests, with cut scores for pharmacists of Reading B, Listening B, Speaking B and Writing C+. All four sub-tests must be completed in a single testing session. The policy says scores are typically valid for two years. It says remotely proctored tests are acceptable if they are as secure, valid and reliable as on-site tests, without naming OET@Home, so each province decides. Ontario: the Ontario College of Pharmacists applies Reading B, Writing C+, Listening B and Speaking B from 1 January 2026, valid for two years, and accepts OET on Paper, OET on Computer and OET@Home. Other provinces: not confirmed here, so read your own college's page. PEBC: we did not read the Pharmacy Examining Board of Canada's pages, so its examination steps are not confirmed in this guide.
Also considering the United States? NABP will accept OET Pharmacy for FPGEC certification for tests taken on or after 11 January 2027, and it requires its English test to be taken at an approved computer-based test centre in an NABP jurisdiction, which covers the United States and the 10 Canadian provinces. Home editions are not accepted, and NABP had not published its minimum OET scores when we checked on 27 November 2026. Read OET for pharmacists in the USA and our USA pathway guide before you book one test for both countries.
Pathway steps
Choose the province Read your pharmacy regulator's own language page. Do not rely on the NAPRA policy alone, and remember Quebec is separate.
Check the examination route The PEBC steps are not confirmed here. Read them on the PEBC website before you plan dates.
Sit OET Pharmacy in one session All four sub-tests together, reaching B, B, B and Writing C+ where the NAPRA cut scores apply.
Send the result within two years Follow the instructions on the Pharmacists' Gateway Canada language page for OET results.
Common mistakes
Treating the NAPRA policy as the rule of every province.
Booking OET@Home outside Ontario without checking the provincial college.
Planning a paper test in 2027: from January 2027 OET on Paper is for Nursing and Medicine only.
Splitting sub-tests across sittings.
Booking the same test for Canada and the United States without reading both sets of rules.
OET preparation focus
Writing
Letters to prescribers and other professionals with accurate medicine details.
Speaking
Medication counselling, adherence, side effects and safe refusal of a sale.
Reading
Medicine information, safety alerts and workplace policies.
Listening
Pharmacist and patient counselling and team handovers.
Do not book the wrong test
Professions where the national body does not accept OET
These bodies publish a closed list of approved English tests. OET is not on any of them, so an OET result will not help your Canadian application in these professions.
Profession Body English tests it lists OET
Physiotherapy CAPR, policy 2.2 (effective 3 March 2025) CELPIP General, IELTS General Training, IELTS Academic, PTE Core, and TEF or TCF for French. All scores in one sitting, received by CAPR within two years of the test date Not accepted
Occupational therapy ACOTRO, SEAS documents CELPIP General, IELTS Academic, IELTS General Training, TOEFL iBT, PTE Core, plus French tests. Same sitting, no more than two years before applying to SEAS Not accepted
Dentistry NDEB and RCDSO (Ontario) NDEB sets no language test, and provincial regulators may ask for evidence before licensure. RCDSO lists IELTS, TOEFL iBT, CELPIP and PTE, valid for two years from the test date. Other provinces: not confirmed Not accepted at RCDSO
Veterinary science CVMA National Examining Board Until 31 December 2026: TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, CAEL. From 1 January 2027: TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic or General Training, CAEL, CELPIP General, PTE Core Not accepted
Not confirmed: we could not open the pages for radiography ( CAMRT ), optometry ( FORAC ) or speech-language pathology (CASLPO in Ontario). Search extracts suggest OET is not on their lists. For dietetics, a search extract suggests the College of Dietitians of Ontario lists OET, but we could not confirm the score. Podiatry was not researched. Treat all five as not confirmed and ask the regulator before you book any test.
If another country on your list accepts OET for your profession, the test can still be worth taking for that country. Compare destinations in our OET recognition by country table . Course pages: physiotherapists , dentists and allied health professions .
Test formats and venues
Paper, computer or OET@Home in Canada
Three separate questions decide your format: what OET lets you book in your country and profession, what your regulator accepts, and how Speaking is delivered.
OET on Paper from January 2027
OET announced on 16 November 2026 that from January 2027 the paper test continues for Nursing and Medicine only. The announcement names no countries. OET's customer care team told us by email in November 2026 that Canada is one of the 16 countries that keep paper testing. Paper sessions are never guaranteed: see our paper test centres 2027 list for Canada .
OET on Computer at a venue
OET says the computer test stays available for all 12 professions at approved venues, subject to availability. On 27 November 2026 the official OET finder listed 16 computer venue records in Canada, including Toronto, Vancouver, Calgary, Ottawa, Halifax and Winnipeg. Venues and sessions change, so check our OET test centres list for Canada and then the finder itself. Speaking on a computer test may be delivered by live video: that is not OET@Home.
OET@Home
OET says OET@Home is offered in countries where taking the test at a venue is not yet available, and Canada has venues. Regulators differ as well: BCCNM is in person only, the Ontario College of Pharmacists accepts OET@Home, NAPRA leaves it to each province, and CPSBC, CPSA and CNO do not say. Read our OET@Home guide first.
Sittings
CPSBC, CNO and the NAPRA policy all ask for the full score in one sitting or attempt. Only the Manitoba nursing document we read mentions two sittings, and we could not confirm that it covers OET. Compare regulators in our OET clubbing rules guide and our score requirements guide .

Canada pathway FAQ
Short answers for healthcare professionals planning Canadian registration and English testing.
Does Canada accept OET? There is no single answer, because health licensing in Canada is provincial. Some regulators accept OET, for example CPSBC and CPSA for doctors, CNO and BCCNM for nurses and the Ontario College of Pharmacists. Others do not, so check your own regulator before booking.
Can I use OET for Express Entry? No. IRCC's Express Entry page lists CELPIP, IELTS and PTE Core for English, and OET is not on that list. If you need both immigration and registration, you may need two different tests.
What OET score do nurses need in Ontario? The College of Nurses of Ontario prints Writing C+ (320), Speaking B (350), Listening B (350) and Reading C+ (330), all in one complete attempt, with the test written within two years of registering.
Do nurses in Alberta or British Columbia need OET? CRNA in Alberta lists only CELBAN and IELTS Academic, so OET is not accepted there. BCCNM in British Columbia accepts OET with Reading C+, Listening B, Writing C+ and Speaking B, in person only.
What OET score do doctors need in British Columbia and Alberta? CPSBC asks for OET Medicine with at least grade B in each component in one sitting, valid for two years from the test date. CPSA asks for at least grade B in each component, taken within 24 months before the application.
Is OET accepted for pharmacists in Canada? NAPRA's model policy recommends OET with Reading B, Listening B, Speaking B and Writing C+ in a single testing session, and each provincial regulator decides whether to adopt it. Ontario applies those cut scores from 1 January 2026 and accepts OET on Paper, OET on Computer and OET@Home.
Do physiotherapists, occupational therapists, dentists or vets need OET for Canada? No. CAPR, ACOTRO, the Royal College of Dental Surgeons of Ontario and the CVMA National Examining Board publish lists of approved English tests, and OET is not on them. Book one of the tests they list instead.
Not sure whether OET fits your Canada plan?
Check your provincial regulator first. If it accepts OET, start with free practice to see your level, then choose the course for your profession. If you are unsure, message us with your profession and province and we will point you to the right official page.

## New Zealand Pathway Guide 2027: OET Scores by Board

URL: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/new-zealand-pathway-guide.html

New Zealand OET guide for 2027: the scores, sittings, validity and test formats each health board accepts, from MCNZ and the Nursing Council to Immigration NZ.

Free Resource - Edition 2027 New Zealand Pathway Guide: OET scores by board
New Zealand has no single English rule for health professionals. Each responsible authority sets its own OET score, sitting rule and validity period. This guide lists what eleven authorities and Immigration New Zealand publish, profession by profession, with a link to every source.
By Dr Ahmed Hesham , medical doctor and founder of OET with Dr Hesham · Published 27 Nov 2026
Last verified: 27 November 2026. Every rule below was read on the regulator's own page or policy on that date. Where a source was silent or could not be read, we say "not confirmed".

Match the OET score and sitting rule

Check validity against your application date
Then book the test
New Zealand pathway overview
In New Zealand each health profession has its own responsible authority: a council or a board. There is no shared English standard, so two colleagues in different professions can face different OET scores, different sitting rules and different validity periods. The table covers all 12 OET professions. "Accepted" means the authority names OET in the document we read. "Not confirmed" means the document is silent or we could not read a primary source, so you must ask the authority.
Choose your regulator first. Then confirm the accepted test and the accepted format before you book. OET does not work the same way for every profession.
Important: This guide is educational orientation only. It is not legal, immigration or regulator advice, and regulators can change their rules without notice. We are an independent coaching service, not part of OET, any regulator or any test centre. Always read the rule on the regulator's own page before you book a test or pay a fee.
Profession Responsible authority OET Minimum OET Sittings Validity OET@Home
Medicine Medical Council of New Zealand (MCNZ) Accepted Medical module: Listening 350, Reading 350, Speaking 350, Writing 300 One sitting, or two within 12 months, all four tested each time, none below 300 Within 2 years of the application, or of the NZREX Clinical date Not confirmed
Nursing Nursing Council of New Zealand Accepted Reading 350, Listening 350, Speaking 350, Writing 300 More than one sitting allowed; all scores within 12 months of the first sitting All sittings within three years of starting the application Not accepted OET on computer at a venue is accepted
Pharmacy Pharmacy Council Accepted A or B in each of the four bands Earlier OET results within a two-year period can be used Within 2 years of the application Not confirmed
Physiotherapy Physiotherapy Board Accepted Reading 350, Listening 350, Speaking 350, Writing 300 Two sittings in six months Less than 2 years old on the day you apply Not confirmed
Dentistry Dental Council Accepted A or B in each of the four components One sitting; no one-skill retakes 2 years Not confirmed
Veterinary Science Veterinary Council of New Zealand (VCNZ) Accepted A or B in each of the 4 sections One sitting 2 years, longer in one defined case Not confirmed
Occupational Therapy Occupational Therapy Board (OTBNZ) Accepted OET Occupational Therapy: B in each of the four components Results can be combined; standard reached within 12 months of the first test No older than 24 months when submitted Not confirmed
Optometry Optometrists and Dispensing Opticians Board (ODOB) Accepted OET Optometry: B (350) in each of the four components One result No more than 2 years old when the Board receives the application Not accepted In person only
Radiography Medical Radiation Technologists Board (MRTB) Accepted B in all four sections Not confirmed Not confirmed Not confirmed
Dietetics Dietitians Board Accepted A or B in all four sections Not confirmed Within the 12 months before the Board receives the application Not confirmed
Podiatry Podiatrists Board Accepted OET certificate, "Grades A and B" (the wording on the registration form) Not confirmed Not confirmed Not confirmed
Speech Pathology No regulator source read Not confirmed Not confirmed Not confirmed Not confirmed Not confirmed
For the same comparison across other countries see OET recognition by country and OET score requirements . Australia works differently, with one standard for all boards: see the Australia pathway guide .
Four checks before you book
Most wasted test fees come from booking before reading the regulator's rule. Run these four checks in order.
1. Your regulator
Find the council or board for your profession in the table above and open its own document. A score that satisfies one board can fail another.
2. Sittings
Some authorities let you combine sittings inside a fixed window. Others want one sitting. The detail is in each section below and in our guide to combining OET sittings .
3. Test format
Paper, computer at a venue and OET@Home are three different formats. A computer test at a venue with Speaking by video is not OET@Home. Whether you can book OET@Home is OET's rule. Whether your regulator accepts it is a separate question. See OET@Home: who accepts it .
4. Validity
Count the validity period from the date the authority uses: the application date, the exam date or the day it receives your file. The Dietitians Board uses 12 months, not 2 years.
Medical Council of New Zealand
Doctors: Medical Council of New Zealand
The rules come from the Council's Policy on English language requirements , dated September 2026. OET is one of several ways to meet the requirement.
Not confirmed: an NZREX Clinical application form may print a different score wording from the September 2026 policy. We could not read that form directly. If you are an NZREX candidate, ask the Council which wording applies before you book.
Rule What the regulator publishes
OET version The Medical module of OET.
Minimum scores Speaking 350, Listening 350, Reading 350, Writing 300.
Sittings One sitting. Or a maximum of two sittings in a 12-month period, only if you are tested in all four components at each sitting and no score from either sitting is below 300.
Validity Within 2 years of an application for registration, or within 2 years of the NZREX Clinical examination date for a new candidate.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The policy says nothing about the delivery format. Ask the Council before you book OET@Home.
Without a test The policy lists other routes, for example a New Zealand primary medical qualification, or English as a first language with a qualification from Australia, the UK, Ireland, the USA or an English-instruction Canadian or South African school, or recent work as a registered doctor in an English-speaking setting with two senior-doctor referees. Read the exact conditions in the policy.
Other tests IELTS Academic: Speaking 7.0, Listening 7.0, Reading 7.0, Writing 6.5.
Registration route: NZREX Clinical
The NZREX Clinical is an OSCE with 12 stations and lasts 3 hours.
Before it you need a pass, within 5 years of your allocated exam date, in one of: PLAB Part 1, MCCQE Part I, the AMC MCQ, or USMLE Steps 1 and 2 CK.
Your English result must be valid, that is passed within two years, at your allocated exam date.
A pass is valid for 5 years and must be followed by a PGY1 post with an accredited provider.
Exam dates printed on the Council page when we checked: 6 March 2027 and 4 September 2027.
What this guide does not cover
The Council has other registration pathways besides NZREX Clinical. We did not read them, so they are not described here.
Do not assume the two-sitting rule lets you resit a single sub-test: all four components must be tested each time.
Preparing for OET Medicine? See the OET course for doctors .
Nursing Council of New Zealand
Nurses: Nursing Council of New Zealand
The rules come from the Council's English Language Competence Policy Guidance (dated 19 August 2022) and its requirements page for internationally qualified nurses .
Rule What the regulator publishes
Minimum scores At least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking, and at least 300 in Writing.
Sittings The scores can be reached over more than one sitting. All required scores must be met within 12 months of your first sitting, and all sittings must fall within three years of starting your application. No minimum score per sitting is printed.
One test only You cannot mix tests, for example OET for two skills and IELTS for the other two.
Paper and computer Accepted The test must be taken at an OET test centre, on paper or on computer.
OET@Home Not accepted The Council does not currently accept tests taken completely online, such as OET@Home.
Speaking by video at a venue Accepted OET on computer at an approved venue, with the Speaking sub-test hosted online, is accepted. That is not OET@Home.
Without a test Nursing education in Canada, Ireland, Singapore, the United Kingdom or the United States; or current registration in Canada, Ireland, the UK or the USA where you sat a test to gain it. Nurses registered in Australia apply under the Trans-Tasman Mutual Recognition Act 1997 and need no English evidence.
Other tests IELTS Academic: 7 in Reading, Listening and Speaking, 6.5 in Writing. The Council page says it does not accept PTE.
Registration route in brief
Identity check and application through TruMerit.
Current overseas registration and an equivalent nursing qualification.
At least 1,800 hours of practice after registration.
For some registered nurses and all enrolled nurses, a competence assessment: an online theory exam at a Pearson test centre, then a two-day orientation and a three-hour OSCE in Christchurch.
The Welcome to Aotearoa New Zealand Programme and a criminal history check.
Before you book
Nursing is one of the two professions that keep the paper test from January 2027, where a paper session is offered.
Watch both clocks: 12 months from your first sitting for the scores, three years for all sittings.
Preparing for OET Nursing? See the OET course for nurses .
Pharmacy Council
Pharmacists: Pharmacy Council
The rules come from the Council's English language requirements page and its page for pharmacists from other countries .
Rule What the regulator publishes
Minimum scores An A or B score in each of the four bands: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Validity Achieved within two years of the date of application.
Sittings If you do not reach all the scores at one sitting, results from earlier OET tests obtained within a two-year period are accepted. The page prints no minimum per sitting and no maximum number of sittings.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The page does not mention the delivery format.
Without a test Not required if you are registered in Australia, Canada, Ireland, the UK or the USA.
Other tests IELTS Academic: at least 7.0 in each of the four bands.
Registration route for other countries
Preliminary Review first. You cannot continue with any other step until it is approved.
Then OPRA, run by the Australian Pharmacy Council (two attempts in total), and the New Zealand Pharmacy Legislation course, both within 2 years of the Preliminary Review approval.
Then intern registration, the Intern Training Programme, which starts in February each year, and the Assessment Centre.
Then registration as a pharmacist.
Before you book
Timing note printed by the Council: applicants from 2 July 2026 will not be able to meet all the requirements in time for the 2027 intern programme.
Pharmacy has no paper test from January 2027. Plan for OET on computer at a venue and ask the Council about the format if you are considering anything else.
Preparing for OET Pharmacy? See the OET course for pharmacists .
Physiotherapy Board
Physiotherapists: Physiotherapy Board
The rules come from the Board's Help Portal article English proficiency evidence (last updated 5 June 2025). The Board's main website blocked our reading on 27 November 2026, so some details stay "not confirmed".
Rule What the regulator publishes
Minimum scores At least 350 for Reading, Listening and Speaking, and at least 300 for Writing.
Sittings OET scores may be obtained across two sittings in six months. Not confirmed The further conditions (all areas tested at both sittings, and a lowest allowed score per sitting) could not be read on a primary page. Ask the Board before you rely on two sittings.
Validity Test results must be less than 2 years old on the date you submit your application.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The article does not mention the delivery format.
Without a test Confirmation that English is your first language; or a physiotherapy qualification from the United Kingdom, Ireland, Canada or South Africa; or other evidence with the Registrar's prior permission.
Other tests IELTS Academic (7 for Reading, Listening and Speaking, 6.5 for Writing), PTE Academic and TOEFL iBT are also listed.
Registration route
The Board publishes an International Express Pathway and an International General Pathway.
Not confirmed We could not read either pathway page, so the steps are not described here. Read them on the Board's website.
Before you book
Physiotherapy has no paper test from January 2027. Plan for OET on computer at a venue.
The six-month window is short. Book the second sitting early if you may need it.
Preparing for OET Physiotherapy? See the OET course for physiotherapists .
Dentists, vets and allied health: board by board
Seven more authorities name OET. Their rules differ in small but costly ways: one sitting or several, 12 months or 24, in person only or silent on format. For allied health preparation see OET for allied health professionals .
Dentistry: Dental Council
Accepted for dentists, dental specialists, oral health therapists, dental therapists, hygienists and clinical dental technicians.
Minimum: a pass with A or B grades in each of the four components.
Sittings: the test must be passed in one sitting. One-skill retakes are not accepted.
Validity: a pass is valid for two years.
OET@Home: Not confirmed The page is silent.
Route: you need a prescribed qualification recognised by the Council; otherwise individual assessment or the registration examination. The examination details are not confirmed here.
Source: Dental Council, registration: what you need to know . Course: OET for dentists .
Veterinary Science: Veterinary Council (VCNZ)
Accepted Minimum: a pass with A or B grades in each of the 4 sections at 1 sitting.
Validity: 2 years. It may be extended up to 5 years for applicants who lived and worked in an English-first country for 4 of the previous 5 years.
OET@Home and the required OET profession version: Not confirmed
The policy was last reviewed in December 2017. Ask the Council whether it is still current before you book.
Source: VCNZ Policy on English Competence and English Tests .
Occupational Therapy: OTBNZ
Accepted OET Occupational Therapy, minimum B in each of the four components.
Sittings: you may combine the results of more than one attempt, but the standard must be reached within 12 months of sitting the first test.
Validity: results must be no older than 24 months when they are submitted.
OET@Home: Not confirmed The policy is silent.
Without a test: education in New Zealand, Australia, Canada, the Republic of Ireland, South Africa or the United Kingdom.
Route: overseas qualifications are assessed individually. See OTBNZ overseas applicants .
Source: OTBNZ Policy 704, English language policy for registration (version 2.0, reviewed September 2025).
Optometry: ODOB
Accepted OET Optometry, a minimum B pass (or a score of 350) in each of the four components, in one result.
Not accepted for online and distance tests. Tests must be taken in person, handwritten or on computer.
Validity: no more than two years old when the Board receives the application.
Exemptions are narrow and defined in the policy.
Source: ODOB English Language Policy for Registration (version 1.3, approved 21 September 2026).
Radiography: MRTB
Accepted Minimum: a pass with B in all four sections.
Validity and sittings for OET: Not confirmed The policy prints them for IELTS (one sitting, within two years) but not for OET.
OET@Home: Not confirmed We could not read a primary page on it. Plan for a test centre unless the Board tells you otherwise.
Without a test: several defined routes, including a Board-accredited qualification.
Source: MRTB Policy: English language proficiency (August 2024).
Dietetics: Dietitians Board
Accepted Minimum: an A or B in all four sections.
Validity: all components must be passed and dated within the 12 months before the Board receives the application. That is 12 months, not 2 years.
Combining sittings and OET@Home: Not confirmed
Source: Dietitians Board, English language requirements .
Podiatry: Podiatrists Board
Accepted The registration form asks for an OET certificate, "Grades A and B".
It applies to applicants for whom English is a second language, with exceptions printed on the form.
Validity, sittings, OET@Home and the OET profession version: Not confirmed The form states none of them.
Source: Podiatrists Board application for registration (updated August 2024).
Speech Pathology
Not confirmed We read no primary source for speech-language therapy in New Zealand, so this guide states no OET requirement.
Ask the body that would recognise your qualification, and your employer, which English evidence it wants before you book any test.
Immigration New Zealand is a separate rule
Registration and immigration are two different decisions by two different bodies. Immigration New Zealand accepts OET for skilled residence, at its own threshold. That threshold is lower than the score of every health regulator in this guide.
Do not aim for the visa score. A visa-level OET result does not satisfy registration. If you need both, the regulator's score is the one to plan for.
Rule What Immigration New Zealand publishes
OET accepted Accepted OET is on the list of accepted tests for skilled residence.
Principal applicant Grade C+ or higher in all four skills: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Non-principal applicants Grade C or higher in all four skills.
Format Not accepted for at-home tests. You must sit the test in person at a test centre.
Validity The result must be no more than 2 years old when you apply.
Other visa categories Not confirmed We read the skilled residence instructions only.
Sources: Immigration New Zealand, English language requirements for skilled residence visas and Amendment Circular 2026-21 (7 August 2026).
Test formats and venues in New Zealand
Test centres belong to OET's network, not to us. We list what OET's own venue finder showed on 27 November 2026. A listed venue is not a promise of an open seat on your date.
OET on computer at a venue
OET says the computer test at a venue stays available for all 12 professions. On 27 November 2026 the finder listed one computer venue record in New Zealand. See OET test centres in New Zealand .
OET on paper from January 2027
OET announced on 16 November 2026 that the paper test continues for Nursing and Medicine only. New Zealand is one of the 16 countries named in an email from OET customer care (November 2026), not on oet.com. Paper sessions are never guaranteed. See paper test centres 2027: New Zealand and what changes in January 2027 .
OET@Home
Three separate questions: can you book it from your country and profession (OET's rule), will your regulator accept it, and is a venue test with Speaking by video the same thing (it is not). In New Zealand the Nursing Council, ODOB and Immigration New Zealand do not accept at-home tests. For the others it is not confirmed. See OET@Home: who accepts it .
Book only through OET's official booking page . OET's own fee and its terms are on oet.com.
Candidate checklist before you start
Name your responsible authority and open its own English policy.
Write down four things: the OET profession version, the minimum scores, the sitting rule and the validity period.
Confirm the accepted format in writing if the policy is silent: paper, computer at a venue, or OET@Home.
If you also need a visa, read the Immigration New Zealand rule separately and plan for the higher regulator score.
Check the venue and the date in the OET finder before you fix your study plan.
Count the validity period back from your planned application date, not from today.
Take the free placement test and start with free OET practice to see how far you are from the score.

Frequently asked questions
Short answers for candidates planning OET and registration in New Zealand.
Is OET accepted for health registration in New Zealand? Yes for most professions. The eleven responsible authorities we read on 27 November 2026 all list OET: medicine, nursing, pharmacy, physiotherapy, dentistry, veterinary science, occupational therapy, optometry, medical radiation technology, dietetics and podiatry. We could not confirm a rule for speech-language therapy. Each authority sets its own scores, sittings and validity.
What OET score do nurses need for New Zealand? The Nursing Council of New Zealand asks for at least 350 in Reading, Listening and Speaking and at least 300 in Writing. The scores can come from more than one sitting, but all of them must be reached within 12 months of your first sitting.
What OET score do doctors need for the Medical Council of New Zealand? The Medical Council policy dated September 2026 asks for the Medical module with at least 350 in Speaking, Listening and Reading and at least 300 in Writing. You can use one sitting, or two sittings within 12 months if all four components are tested each time and no score is below 300. The wording on the NZREX Clinical application form is not confirmed, so check with the Council before you book.
Does New Zealand accept OET@Home? It depends on the authority. The Nursing Council does not accept OET@Home, but it accepts OET on computer at a venue with the Speaking sub-test hosted online. The Optometrists and Dispensing Opticians Board accepts tests taken in person only. Immigration New Zealand does not accept at-home tests. For the other authorities it is not confirmed, so ask in writing before you book.
Can I combine two OET sittings for New Zealand? Some authorities allow it and some do not. The Nursing Council, the Medical Council, the Pharmacy Council, the Physiotherapy Board and the Occupational Therapy Board publish rules for using more than one sitting. The Dental Council, the Veterinary Council and the Optometrists and Dispensing Opticians Board ask for one sitting or one result.
Is the OET score for a New Zealand visa the same as for registration? No. Immigration New Zealand accepts OET for skilled residence at Grade C+ or higher in all four skills for the principal applicant. That is lower than the score of every health regulator in this guide, so a visa-level result does not satisfy registration. Plan for the regulator score.
Can I still take OET on paper in New Zealand in 2027? From January 2027 OET says the paper test continues for Nursing and Medicine only. New Zealand is on the 16-country list that OET customer care sent by email in November 2026, but paper sessions are never guaranteed. Every other profession should plan for OET on computer at a venue.
Know your New Zealand target score? Start preparing.
Confirm the rule on your regulator's own page first. Then tell us your profession, your target score and your test date, and we will point you to the right preparation step.

## Singapore Pathway Guide 2027: SMC, SPC, SDC and AHPC

URL: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/singapore-pathway-guide.html

Singapore OET guide for 2027: the scores SMC, SPC, SDC and AHPC ask for, the single-sitting rule, validity, and why the Nursing Board lists no English test.

Free Resource - Edition 2027 Singapore Pathway Guide: OET for SMC, SPC, SDC and AHPC
Singapore regulates each health profession through its own council or board. Four of them list OET for foreign-trained applicants: SMC for doctors, SPC for pharmacists, SDC for dentists and AHPC for allied health. The Singapore Nursing Board lists no English test. This guide sets out what each body publishes, with a link to every source.
By Dr Ahmed Hesham , medical doctor and founder of OET with Dr Hesham · Published 27 Nov 2026
Last verified: 27 November 2026. Every rule below was read on the regulator's own page on that date. Where a page was silent or was not read, we say "not confirmed".

Singapore pathway overview
Singapore has documented OET recognition, but not for every profession. The table covers all 12 OET professions honestly. "Accepted" means the regulator names OET on the page we read. "Not listed" means the regulator's page names no English test. "Not confirmed" means we read no primary source, so this guide states no rule.
Choose your regulator first. Then confirm the accepted test and the accepted format before you book. Do not assume OET is the route because it works for a colleague in another profession.
Important: This guide is educational orientation only. It is not legal, immigration or regulator advice, and regulators can change their rules without notice. We are an independent coaching service, not part of OET, any regulator or any test centre. Always read the rule on the regulator's own page before you book a test or pay a fee.

For the same comparison across other countries see OET recognition by country and OET score requirements .
Four checks before you book
Singapore's rules are stricter on sittings than many other destinations. Run these four checks in order.
1. Your regulator
SMC, SPC, SDC, AHPC or SNB. Open its own page. If you are a nurse, read the nursing section first: SNB lists no English test.
2. Whether you need a test
Each council exempts some applicants, usually by where the qualification was taught. Check whether the rule applies to you before paying for any test.
3. Single sitting
All four councils that list OET want every score from one sitting. Combining results is not an option here. Compare other regulators in our guide to combining OET sittings .
4. Test format
OET@Home acceptance is not confirmed for any Singapore council. Whether you can book OET@Home is OET's rule. Whether your council accepts it is a separate question. See OET@Home: who accepts it .
Singapore Medical Council
Doctors: Singapore Medical Council (SMC)
The rules come from the SMC page Documents for submission and processing time (last updated 2 September 2026).
Rule What the regulator publishes
Who needs it International medical graduates whose basic medical degree is from a school where English is not the medium of instruction.
OET Accepted At least Grade B in each of the four components: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Sittings The results must be obtained in a single sitting.
Validity Accepted only within 2 years from the date of the test.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The page states no delivery format for OET.
Exception Clinical Observers on temporary registration do not need to submit English test results.
Other tests IELTS Academic with at least 7 in each component. TOEFL iBT is also listed, with scores that depend on the test date (before, or on and after, 21 January 2026).
Registration route
Registration depends on holding a recognised qualification and an offer of employment.
Not confirmed We did not read the registration categories or the list of recognised medical schools, so they are not described here. Read them on the SMC website before you plan.
Before you book
One sitting only: a strong result in three components does not carry over to a later test.
Count the 2 years from your test date to the date SMC will use your result.
Preparing for OET Medicine? See the OET course for doctors .
Singapore Nursing Board
Nurses: Singapore Nursing Board (SNB)
The SNB page for foreign-trained nurses and midwives (last updated 9 June 2026) lists no English test: not OET, not IELTS, not TOEFL.
Nurses, read this first: do not assume OET is your route to Singapore. SNB does not list it. Book OET only if your employer, or another regulator you are also applying to, asks for it in writing.
Rule What the regulator publishes
English test Not listed The page names no English test for foreign-trained nurses and midwives.
Job offer You must have an offer of employment with an eligible healthcare institution (with inpatient services) in Singapore.
Qualification Completion of a pre-registration or pre-enrolment nursing or midwifery programme, and nursing or midwifery registration from the country where you trained.
Assessment You may need to sit a Licensure Examination, undergo a competency assessment, or be placed on provisional registration.
Documents Documents that are not in English need a certified official translation in English.
OET in practice Not confirmed Whether SNB or an employer accepts or asks for OET is outside the page we read.
What to do instead
Start with the employer: the job offer comes first in the SNB process.
Ask the employer in writing whether it wants an English test, which one, and which score.
If you are also applying to another country, plan the test around that regulator's rule.
Nursing elsewhere
Other destinations publish clear OET rules for nurses. Compare them in OET score requirements .
Neighbouring systems: the Australia pathway guide and the New Zealand pathway guide .
Preparing for OET Nursing for another regulator? See the OET course for nurses .
Singapore Pharmacy Council
Pharmacists: Singapore Pharmacy Council (SPC)
The rules come from the SPC pages Evidence of proficiency in English language (last updated 15 July 2026) and Foreign-trained pharmacy graduates and pharmacists (last updated 9 October 2026).
Rule What the regulator publishes
Who needs it International pharmacy graduates who obtained their pharmacy degree outside the UK, USA, Canada, Australia or New Zealand, at the point of application for pre-registration training.
OET Accepted OET under the profession Pharmacy, with at least 350 in each of the four components.
Sittings The results must be obtained at one sitting.
Validity Within 2 years before the date of application for pre-registration training.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The page states no delivery format for OET.
Other tests IELTS Academic with an overall score of at least 7 and at least 7 in each of the four components. TOEFL iBT is also listed, with scores that depend on the test date.
Registration route in brief
A university degree accepted by SPC, and a job offer: SPC will not consider an application without one.
Pre-registration training, which ranges from 3 to 12 months.
The Competency Examination and the Forensic Examination, each with a pass mark of 60.
Conditional registration for at least 12 months under an approved supervisor, then full registration.
Before you book
SPC uses numbers, not grades: 350 in every component, at one sitting.
The 2 years are counted back from your application for pre-registration training, so time the test to the job offer.
Preparing for OET Pharmacy? See the OET course for pharmacists .
Singapore Dental Council
Dentists: Singapore Dental Council (SDC)
The English rule is printed on the SDC page Criteria for the Qualifying Examination (last updated 6 May 2026). The conditional registration page itself mentions no English test.
Rule What the regulator publishes
Who needs it Foreign-trained applicants whose first language is not English.
OET Accepted At least Grade B in each of the four components: Listening, Reading, Writing and Speaking.
Sittings The scores must be obtained in a single sitting.
Validity A 2-year validity period based on the date of the test.
Paper, computer, OET@Home Not confirmed The page states no delivery format for OET.
Other tests IELTS Academic with at least 7 in all four components. TOEFL iBT is also listed, with scores that depend on the test date.
Registration route
Conditional registration means working under the supervision of a fully registered dentist approved by the Council.
Not confirmed A change that would make a Qualifying Examination compulsory before conditional registration at a future date could not be read on a primary page. Check the SDC announcements before you plan.
Before you book
Dentistry has no OET paper test from January 2027, and Singapore has no paper venue in any case. Plan for OET on computer.
One sitting only, Grade B in all four.
Preparing for OET Dentistry? See OET for dentists .
Allied Health Professions Council
Allied health: AHPC
The rules come from the AHPC page Requirements for registration application (last updated 24 July 2026). It covers physiotherapy, occupational therapy, speech-language therapy, diagnostic radiography and radiation therapy.
Check the wording: we read the AHPC table as a summary, not as quoted sentences. Open the page and read your profession's row yourself. The radiography row shows OET Grade B beside a lower IELTS figure, so radiographers should confirm their row with AHPC.
Profession Minimum OET in the AHPC table
Physiotherapy Grade B or above. The table adds that computer-based testing is also accepted for Physiotherapy.
Occupational Therapy Grade B or above.
Diagnostic Radiography and Radiation Therapy Grade B or above.
Speech-Language Therapy Grade B (400) in three components and Grade B (350) in one, with effect from 1 August 2025.
Rules that apply to all five
Only results taken within 2 years before the registration application date are accepted.
All components must be met in a single examination sitting. There is no limit on the number of attempts.
No English test is needed where the basic qualification is from Singapore, Australia, Canada (except Quebec), New Zealand, the Republic of Ireland, South Africa, the UK or the USA.
Everyone else must show English proficiency before conditional registration.
OET@Home: Not confirmed
Route and other professions
If your qualification is not on the AHPC recognised list, you take a Qualifying Examination. The examination provider does not accept an application without a referral letter from AHPC.
For diagnostic radiographers and radiation therapists, an AHPC announcement of 26 September 2022 said the OET and IELTS score requirement was unchanged for the time being.
Dietetics and podiatry do not appear in the table we read. Not confirmed Optometry and veterinary science have other regulators that we did not read. Not confirmed
Preparing for an allied health version of OET? See OET for allied health professionals and the OET course for physiotherapists .
Test formats and venues in Singapore

On 27 November 2026 the finder listed one computer venue record in Singapore. OET says the computer test at a venue stays available for all 12 professions. See OET test centres in Singapore .
OET on paper
The finder listed no paper venue in Singapore. From January 2027 the paper test continues for Nursing and Medicine only ( OET, 16 November 2026 ), and Singapore is not among the 16 countries named in the OET customer care email of November 2026.
OET@Home
Not confirmed for SMC, SPC, SDC or AHPC: none of the pages we read mentions it. A venue test with Speaking by video is not OET@Home. Ask your council in writing before you book. See OET@Home: who accepts it .
Book only through OET's official booking page . OET's own fee and its terms are on oet.com.

Frequently asked questions
Short answers for candidates planning OET and registration in Singapore.
Is OET accepted in Singapore? Yes for some professions. On 27 November 2026 the Singapore Medical Council, the Singapore Pharmacy Council, the Singapore Dental Council and the Allied Health Professions Council all listed OET as English evidence for foreign-trained applicants who need it. The Singapore Nursing Board page for foreign-trained nurses lists no English test at all.
Do nurses need OET for Singapore? The Singapore Nursing Board page for foreign-trained nurses and midwives does not list OET or any other English test. It asks for a job offer from an eligible healthcare institution, your nursing qualification and your registration in the country where you trained. Whether an employer asks for an English test is not confirmed, so ask your employer before you book OET.
What OET score do doctors need for the Singapore Medical Council? The Singapore Medical Council asks for at least Grade B in each of the four components, obtained in a single sitting. The result is accepted only within 2 years from the date of the test. The rule applies to international medical graduates whose basic degree is from a school where English is not the medium of instruction.
What OET score do pharmacists need for the Singapore Pharmacy Council? The Singapore Pharmacy Council asks for OET Pharmacy with at least 350 in each of the four components, obtained at one sitting, within 2 years before the date you apply for pre-registration training. The rule applies to graduates whose pharmacy degree is from outside the UK, USA, Canada, Australia and New Zealand.
Does Singapore accept OET@Home? Not confirmed. None of the four council pages we read mentions OET@Home or any delivery format for OET, apart from a note in the allied health table that computer-based testing is also accepted for Physiotherapy. Ask your council in writing before you book an at-home test.
Can I combine two OET sittings for Singapore? No. The four councils that list OET all ask for the required scores in a single sitting. The Allied Health Professions Council sets no limit on the number of attempts, but each attempt must reach every score on its own.
Where can I sit OET in Singapore? On 27 November 2026 the OET venue finder listed one computer test venue in Singapore and no paper venue. Seats and dates change, so confirm in the finder before you fix your plan.

## OET للصيادلة في أمريكا 2027: قبول NABP وشهادة FPGEC | د. أحمد هشام

URL: https://oetwithdrhesham.co.uk/ar/oet-for-pharmacists-usa.html

تقبل NABP اختبار OET Pharmacy لشهادة FPGEC من 11 يناير 2027، ودرجات OET لم تُنشر بعد. من يستطيع استخدامه، وقاعدة مراكز الاختبار، والمقارنة مع TOEFL iBT.

مسارات الترخيص
OET للصيادلة في أمريكا 2027: قبول NABP وشهادة FPGEC والدرجات ومراكز الاختبار
نعم: من 11 يناير 2027 تقبل NABP (الرابطة الوطنية لمجالس الصيدلة في أمريكا) اختبار OET Pharmacy بديلاً عن TOEFL iBT للحصول على شهادة FPGEC. القرار يخص المتقدمين لامتحان FPGEE في 2027 وما بعدها، ويخص فقط اختبارات OET التي تُؤدّى في هذا التاريخ أو بعده.
هناك نقطتان تحددان هل يفيدك هذا القرار أم لا: NABP لم تنشر بعد درجات OET المطلوبة، والاختبار يجب أن يُؤدّى على الكمبيوتر في مركز اختبار داخل الولايات المتحدة أو كندا. في هذا الدليل تجد ما أكدته NABP، وما لم تؤكده بعد، وكيف تستعد من الآن.
